column1: # One row per pack; tab-separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# group    selection key for the workflow input (one or more per run, or "all")
# extract  Geofabrik path without ".osm.pbf". Prefer the SMALLEST region
#          that fully contains the bbox (state/province instead of country)
#          — download + osmium time scale with extract size. The worker
#          resolves <basename(extract)>.osm.pbf, so basenames must be unique
#          Packs sharing one extract are ingested back-to-back from it.
# bbox     west south east north (EPSG:4326), city core + inner suburbs.
# --- Germany (state extracts: 80-700 MB instead of 4.3 GB for germany) ---
# --- Australia (state extracts; southern hemisphere = year-round users) ---
